blocks.text: ANTIPOLO — Clearskiiin debuted in style in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference, taking down 3B, 21-25, 25-15, 25-22, 25-16, on Thursday at Ynares Center Antipolo. Veteran Ruvince Abrot rallied the UV Smashers back after losing the first set, leading the collective effort with 13 points off 10 kills, two aces, and a block after starting in the last three sets.
